verdict.rationale: Analytical aggregation is a fair axis for a database platform, but the evidence never documents an analytical or columnar query capability, or dashboard-speed aggregation over large tables. The closest items are read replicas that reduce primary load, NVMe Metal storage for high-IOPS workloads, and sharding. These are adjacent general-performance features, not documented analytics support, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run heavy analytical aggregations over large tables fast enough for dashboards without exporting to a separate warehouse
